Well, we all are going to die.
I want to apologize for a statement that I made.

spoken_summary: There is no audible dialogue. The audio is a song with the repeated lyric 'What the hell?'. All dialogue is presented through on-screen captions. The captions show an audience member saying 'People are going to die because of these Medicaid cuts!', the senator responding 'Well, we all are going to die,' and later apologizing for her statement by saying 'we are all going to perish from this earth' and telling people to 'embrace Jesus Christ.' Finally, when asked for a comment on her town hall, she says 'I'm very compassionate.'

central_claim: A female senator is callous and out of touch, as shown by her bizarre and unempathetic responses to concerns about deaths from Medicaid cuts.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel outrage and disbelief toward the senator, viewing her as hypocritical, incompetent, and unfit for office.
